description: Outputs written by the standard NonLinLoc adapter.

files.located_events.csv: Parsed locations when NLLoc locates at least one event
files.run_result.json: Run status, input/output paths, binary directory and located-event count
files.loc/: Native NLLoc location products and logs

failure: The adapter exits non-zero and emits a JSON error on stderr when a required input, executable, or native stage fails.
